testcase.name: Scenario: Preserve a hidden panel when changing ribbon docking position: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:88:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Preserve a hidden panel when changing ribbon docking position ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top with Modify visible ✔ When the user hides Modify through Show Panels ✔ Then the Modify panel disappears from the ribbon ✔ When the user docks the ribbon on the left ✔ Then the ribbon is docked on the left ✔ And the Modify group remains hidden ✔ When the user opens Show Panels on the left-docked ribbon ✔ Then Modify is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Modify ✔ Then the Modify group returns to the left-docked ribbon
